name: bandit
description: Bandit is a pixel-art raccoon that lives on every webpage. He acts as your AI sidekick, helping you write better prompts, summarize long chats, and providing a fun, interactive desktop-pet experience!

scripts.package:firefox: node build.js firefox && cd dist/firefox && zip -r ../bandit-firefox-v6.0.0.zip . -x "*.DS_Store*"
scripts.package:chrome: node build.js chrome && cd dist/chrome && zip -r ../bandit-chrome-v6.0.0.zip . -x "*.DS_Store*"
scripts.package:all: npm run package:firefox && npm run package:chrome
